claims.summary: Single-model-judge promotion evidence is parsed and semantically audited against the canonical quality ruler, adapter identity, and frozen held-out benchmark instead of being accepted from status plus file hash.
Promotion judgment requires fifty source-bound held-out trials, all nine rubric dimensions, balanced side placement, byte-verified scorecards, and stable scoring-first A/B plus B/A decisions.

Semantic evidence must compare identical adapter outputs against exact base-only Scion and a concrete GPT-5.4-mini reference while clearing global and per-domain preference and score thresholds plus lower compiler burden versus base.
Scorecard verification rejects unsafe or symlinked paths before reading bytes, and the adapter promotion report exposes semantic audit status and defects for external evidence.

The release improves the promotion ruler without creating a fresh judgment, changing model weights, activating an adapter, completing device evidence, or claiming base or paid-reference quality superiority.
